name: Vesicular-Tombolo
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past towering mountain ranges, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in copper and titanium and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
